methodology.query_text: Verified GH Archive IssuesEvent opened snapshots (original title and body)
methodology.historical_text: original opening snapshots; edited text excluded unless its availability is before cutoff
methodology.structure: actual Git source snapshot immediately before cutoff
methodology.history: PR merge time, commits, and all path edge timestamps <= cutoff
methodology.ground_truth: functions/methods modified by merged fix PR commits
methodology.selection: first 20 chronological closed issues with merged fix PRs and function changes; no performance-based exclusions
methodology.cold_start: cases with no available historical fixes remain in denominator
methodology.baselines: BM25 or MiniLM issue retrieval, then direct historical-fix projection without expansion
limitations: Twenty issues from one repository; most preceding fixes are not in the 25-PR corpus
Symbols added by a future fix cannot be predicted as existing code
HNSW queries request the full MVP issue corpus before time filtering
Original opening text omits later valid pre-cutoff comments
